title: Rewrite test_filter_morphometrics.py
prompt:
Write a pytest test module at test/morphometrics/test_filter_morphometrics.py for
AxonDeepSeg/morphometrics/filter_morphometrics.py (the `axondeepseg_filter` CLI).

Follow the conventions of the existing tests in test/morphometrics (a `TestCore` class, tests marked
with `@pytest.mark.unit`). Cover `read_config` (default config file and error cases),
`apply_myelinated_rules` and `apply_unmyelinated_rules` (each rule, threshold edge cases, disabled
rules, unknown rules), and `main()` end to end on small morphometrics files created in `tmp_path`.
Do not modify filter_morphometrics.py. The tests must pass on the current code.
final_answer:
All 33 tests pass. Here's a summary of the test module at `test/morphometrics/test_filter_morphometrics.py`:

**`read_config` (6 tests):**
- Returns expected `myelinated`/`unmyelinated` keys from valid config
- Raises `FileNotFoundError` for missing files
- Raises `ValueError` for wrong keys, missing `unmyelinated`, missing `myelinated`
- Works with the default `filter.yaml` shipped with the package

**`apply_myelinated_rules` (8 tests):**
- `valid-g-ratio-only: True` — filters out gratio >= 1, <= 0, and NaN
- `axon-diam-gt` — filters by strict > threshold, tests edge case (exact threshold excluded)
- Disabled rules (`None` and `0` thresholds) — no filtering applied
- Unknown rules — ignored without filtering
- Combined rules — both g-ratio and diameter applied sequentially

**`apply_unmyelinated_rules` (10 tests):**
- `axon-diam-gt` — filter, edge case, disabled
- `solidity-gt` — filter, edge case, disabled
- `axon-area-lt` — filter, edge case, disabled
- Unknown rules — ignored without filtering
- Combined rules — all three rules applied sequentially

**`main()` end-to-end (9 tests):**
- Filters myelinated axons and creates `_filtered.xlsx` output
- Uses default `filter.yaml` config (valid-g-ratio-only)
- Overwrite mode (`-o`) replaces originals, no `_filtered` file created
- Processes folders with multiple morphometrics files
- Processes unmyelinated morphometrics when present
- Empty rules produce unfiltered output
- `SystemExit` raised when required `-i` is missing
- Handles empty (zero-row) morphometrics files
